messages:
Sofia H: Drafting a compact POC provisioning quickstart so SDRs/AE can hand off cleanly. Keeping it actionable.
Liam B: love this. keep steps tiny.
Maya P: adding checklist items below. trying to avoid duplication of other playbooks.
Maya P: HIGH-LEVEL STEPS (short):
1) create trial org/project in Console
2) issue hosted API key scoped to features (expires 14d)
3) set soft quotas (tokens/day + concurrent streams)
4) decide Dedicated vs Hosted fallback plan
5) if Dedicated -> open pool request with sizing + perf window
6) if Private/VPC -> collect CIDRs, peer reqs, and KMS requirements
7) baseline perf + attach logs to ticket
8) confirm pricing credits and add quote line
9) security questionnaire + data flow diagram attached to deal
Liam B: hosted key quick CLI (example):
`rwi api-keys create --org poc-luma --scopes generation,embeddings --ttl 14d --note "POC luma"`

Sofia H: For Dedicated requests include: GPU type, desired max QPS, expected avg seq len, and trial window dates. Sales gets auto 100 GPU-hours unless finance approves more.
Raj K: pool creation snippet for infra team:
```
# create trial pool for POC
rwi pools create --id poc-luma-pool --gpu a100 --replicas 1 --region us-east-1 --labels poc,trial
rwi pools set-autoscale --id poc-luma-pool --min 1 --max 3
```

InfraBot: Ticket PROV-7123 opened for poc-luma (link: https://issues.internal.redwood/PROV-7123)
Maya P: Baseline perf smoke (run once pool ready):
```
# latency smoke: 64-token, 4 concurrent
rwi bench --pool poc-luma-pool --model redwood-3b --seq 64 --concurrency 4 > /tmp/poc-luma-smoke.log
# throughput check: 1024-token, concurrency 2
rwi bench --pool poc-luma-pool --model redwood-7b --seq 1024 --concurrency 2 > /tmp/poc-luma-throughput.log
```

Liam B: Add note: if bench shows 95th pct latency > 250ms for gen-critical flows, mark as "latency-risk" and suggest smaller model or different GPU.
Sofia H: Pricing/credits wording for quotes: "Included: up to 100 GPU-hours of Dedicated runtime during a 14-day POC. Hosted API usage billed per-token beyond included credits." Please standardize this phrasing in handoff docs.
Raj K: Security gates: must attach completed presales questionnaire. For Private deployments include KMS key ARN and whether HSM is required. If HSM requested -> loop in Security and mark as enterprise escalation.
Maya P: Console access notes: SAML SSO required? collect idp metadata + attribute mapping (email->username) before granting console roles. If no SSO, provision a temporary account and force password reset at first login.
Sofia H: Fallback policy: if Dedicated pool cannot reach expected capacity within 48h, notify customer and transparently failover to Hosted compatible model; send template below.

SENT TO CUSTOMER TEMPLATE:
Hi {CustomerName},
We hit an unexpected capacity constraint provisioning the dedicated pool. As a temporary measure we will route traffic to our Hosted inference cluster using a compatible model variant to keep your tests live. This may affect tail latency and cost; we expect to restore dedicated capacity within 24-48h.
Regards,
{AE name}

Maya P: handoff owners (short):
- create project + hosted key -> @Liam B
- dedicated pool request -> @Raj K
- VPC peering + infra checklist -> @Raj K
- security questionnaire -> @Sofia H
- credits/quote update -> @SalesOps

Liam B: timeline suggestion: kickoff within 24-48h of SOW sign, pool bench within 48h of pool ready, weekly syncs during POC.
Raj K: infra tips: prefer A100 for latency SLOs; H100 for high throughput. For very large models (>=70B) call out memory estimate and require Dedicated.
Maya P: SSH / bastion reminder for Private installs (include in ticket):
`ssh -J jump-host@bastion.redwood.internal redwood-admin@10.20.30.5`

Sofia H: edge cases to flag:
- Customer needs data residency -> escalate to Security + Legal
- Customer asks for logs to be shipped to external SIEM -> collect endpoint + retention policy
- Customer requests model weights access -> not allowed for Hosted; escalate for Dedicated/private licensing

Liam B: small ask: can we include a short cost estimate snippet in handoff: e.g., "Estimated hosted token cost: $0.0005/token for gen; Dedicated incremental cost estimate: $X/day for 1 A100 replica". SalesOps will fill numbers.
SalesOps: noted. we'll prepare a pricing calculator widget and attach link to ticket.
Sofia H: If no objections I'll fold this into the canonical POC-runbook in Confluence and tag PROV-7123. Reply if anything missing by EOD.
Liam B: LGTM from me.
Raj K: looks good. I'll kick pool request after AE confirms model/seq expectations.
Maya P: thanks all. closing thread after I move to Confluence.
